label: Bible Study
prompt: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with _____, eternal in the heavens.
verse: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
note: The body is a tent; heaven is a house — and no human builder made it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I laid me down and _____; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
verse: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
note: Written as David fled from his son Absalom — and still he lay down, slept, and woke up safe.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty _____ sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
verse: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
note: Around heaven's throne sit 'four and twenty elders' in white raiment, wearing crowns of gold.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the _____ of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
verse: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
note: The sheep-and-goats judgment: kindness to the overlooked turns out to have been done to the King himself.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the _____ wherewith ye are called,
verse: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
note: Writing as 'the prisoner of the Lord,' Paul urges a walk worthy of your 'vocation' — your calling.
